transform_calibration.data_type: synthetic calibration only; excluded from all DLW results

definitions.error: native physical numerical field minus same-coordinate continuous exact field
definitions.fourier: Two-sided power per bin of weighted-demeaned Hann window, normalized by N^2*mean(w^2)
definitions.wavelet: cmor1.5-1.0; y row closest to zero; |CWT|^2/scale; scales from 4 to min(nx/3,128); e^-2 amplitude edge margin sqrt(2*1.5)*scale*dx
definitions.peaks: signed 5x5 grid extrema >=25% Linf; boundary two cells excluded; strongest 64/sign retained
definitions.components: 8-connected |error| >=50% Linf with >=4 cells; aspect from physical covariance
definitions.not_a_soliton_test: No inverse-scattering eigenvalue computation; Fourier/CWT localization is not evidence of new solitons
